profile.headline:
Senior Software Engineer ✦ Extensive experience in automation & DevOps tools +
methodologies✦ Pairs military background with public sector expertise ✦ Leads High-Performing Teams ✦ Solution Driven
profile.summary:
I am a cutting-edge technology professional with a TS/SCI Clearance, bringing extensive experience in automation and
DevOps tools and methodologies. My career is defined by a commitment to developing and deploying groundbreaking
software solutions that enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and customer satisfaction.

My passion for continuous improvement drives me. As a Senior Software Engineer, I simplify complexity and solve problems
efficiently. My work involves developing custom software automation solutions in Azure using continuous integration and
continuous deployment (CI/CD) methodologies. Leveraging my deep understanding of IT architecture, data analysis, and
various programming languages, I create solutions that meet and exceed customer expectations.

With a blend of military and public sector experiences, I have an acute understanding of diverse processes, enabling me to lead
high-performing teams and teach complex concepts concisely. I foster a culture where team members feel empowered,
supported, and encouraged to innovate. By coordinating with both customers and team members, I motivate everyone to
deliver their best work.

Empathy and collaboration are the cornerstones of my leadership philosophy. I excel in understanding customer and
stakeholder needs, allowing me to develop solutions that address their pain points. My ability to mentor and guide others,
coupled with strong presentation skills, ensures complex ideas are communicated clearly and effectively. I am committed to
fostering an inclusive and supportive team environment where diverse ideas are valued and innovation thrives.

One career highlight at Microsoft was leading the major security project "Learn Linter." This project involved developing a
Visual Studio Code solution offering live authoring feedback, schema-driven UI, and integrated feedback mechanisms powered by C# Language Server and TypeScript VS Code Extension with OpenAI. The project increased compliance with
standards by 23% on average.

My technical expertise extends to Azure Cloud Development, Kubernetes, Docker, Azure DevOps CI/CD, GitHub Actions,
and AI-powered development environment integration. My commitment to cybersecurity is evidenced by my successful
conduct of threat modeling and privacy reviews, ensuring robust security measures are in place.

I am excited to continue pioneering new solutions as I advance in my career.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop and deploy custom software automation solutions in Azure, using continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) methodologies. Innovate widely popular solutions by empathizing with customers and identifying and solving key pain points.
•	Lead teams to develop secure, scalable applications, implement security protocols, and ensure rigorous compliance.
•	Conduct in-depth audits of policies and configurations to identify and resolve inefficiencies, enhancing performance.
•	Restructure processes for increased efficiency and compliance, leveraging a unique security and compliance perspective.
•	Partner with customers to deliver tailored training and troubleshooting, enhancing their understanding and adoption of the company's product suite.
•	Customer Obsessed: Work closely with customers on product design, enhancing their understanding and adoption while maintaining accountability through milestones and roadblocks.
•	Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to align with various security postures as internal ‘Security Champion’, emphasizing the importance of defined roles and teamwork. 
●	Partners with customers to help them better understand, adopt, and deploy the company’s product suite—providing trainings and troubleshooting tailored to the customer’s specific requirements. 
●	Collaborates with cross-functional teams including content architecture, program management, product development, and engineering on custom software automation solutions—integrating team feedback, serving as the automation subject matter expert, and building and implementing new processes and practices that increase technology functionality. and improve customer experience. 
●	Deploys custom software automation in Azure using integration testing and build pipelines, or using continuous integration continuous deployment (CICD) methodologies.

positions.title: Senior Premier Field Engineer
positions.description:
•	Partnered with public sector customers on technology integrations and upgrades, including enterprise deployments, custom tool and script development, and proactive technology enhancements.
•	Ensured seamless teamwork and issue resolution by collaborating with contractors, full-time employees, management, and military personnel while conducting PowerShell workshops across public sector and presenting to large audiences.
o	Fostered collaborative and inclusive environment while educating and empowering clients and team members.
•	Served as training leader for the Microsoft PowerShell Product Team, inclusive of building new workshop content to educate customers on foundational skills, developing interactive lab modules to engage audiences, and leading global audiences through technical trainings.
positions.insights: Training & Development, Microsoft Azure and +4 skills

positions.title: Staff Sergeant
positions.description:
•	Configured and integrated military systems with best practices in defensive measures, including IAVA compliance and patch management, effectively addressing and resolving service outages and network interruptions.
•	Presented strategic network security and operational insights to senior military leaders, contributing to informed decision-making and enhanced security protocols.
•	Led a team in conducting network attack, defense, and exploitation operations, utilizing advanced tools and techniques to meet Combatant Command and national security objectives.
•	Hired and managed trusted personnel, empowering them to perform their roles effectively without micromanagement.
positions.insights: Network Defense, Project Management and +4 skills
